about_intro: A public service for residents of Benjamin Constant to know when the pickup passes and to help look after the environment.
about_what_text: The day and shift of pickup for each neighborhood, city hall notices and a channel to report fires, dumped garbage and deforestation, with photo and map.
about_how_text: The city hall team receives, reviews and forwards it to the responsible body. You follow each stage with the protocol code, no sign-up needed.
about_offline_text: The app is light and keeps the schedule on the device. With no signal, the report is saved and goes out by itself when the connection returns.
about_sample: Sample content: days, neighborhoods and occurrences are still to be checked with the city hall.
legal_sample: Sample text. The city hall and its legal office must review it before publication.
privacy_intro: What we keep, what we do not keep and how you control it.
privacy_anonymous_text: By default a report is anonymous: we do not ask for name, phone or email, and the server keeps nothing about who sent it.
privacy_data_text: We keep the photo and the point marked on the map so the team can find the problem. The photo is shrunk and loses its camera data before sending. The public map shows only the type, status and day.
privacy_contact_text: If you leave a phone or email to get a reply, only the city hall team sees it, and it never appears on the map or in the protocol lookup.
privacy_device_text: The app keeps on this device the neighborhood you chose, the protocol codes you sent and, with no connection, the reports waiting to go out. You can erase everything by clearing the site data in the browser.
privacy_rights_text: Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law you can ask for access, correction or deletion of any data you leave. Contact the Benjamin Constant city hall.
terms_intro: Simple rules for using the service.
terms_use_text: The service is free and open to anyone. Use it to check pickups and to report situations that harm the environment in Benjamin Constant.
terms_faith_text: Send only what you actually saw. A false report, one repeated on purpose or one with insults may be discarded.
terms_emergency_title: This is not an emergency line
terms_emergency_text: The service does not handle emergencies. If there is fire near homes or danger to life, call 193, the Fire Department.
terms_liability_text: The city hall reviews and forwards each report, but the deadline and the solution depend on the responsible body. The protocol shows which stage it is at.
auth_sign_in_description: City hall team access to the reports panel.
